name: Yours Horribly,
source:
You play as a young man by the name of Kane who has been floundering in his gap year between college and his career. 

He runs into an odd woman at a concert and things just seem to get stranger as time goes on, things possibly spiraling out of his control.

Have you caught HER interest or are you unappetizing?

[From [url=https://miximimi.itch.io/yours-horribly-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个名叫凯恩的年轻人，他在大学和职业生涯之间的间隙年一直在挣扎。

他在一场音乐会上遇到了一个奇怪的女人，随着时间的推移，事情似乎变得越来越奇怪，事情可能会超出他的控制范围。

你引起了她的兴趣还是没有胃口？

[来自[url=https://miximimi.itch.io/yours-horribly-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
